_read_me: The ten predefined rules. 'detectable' says whether SiteGuard can check it today. Rules marked false are defined so they can be switched on once a model or sensor exists; they are never enforced now. 'counts_towards_penalty' decides whether a violation of the rule counts towards the penalty rule in penalty_rules.json. Edit freely; confirm severities with your safety officer.

rules.name: Safety helmet
rules.note: Worn on the head, not carried or lying nearby

rules.name: Hand protection (gloves)
rules.note: Needs the second model; per-item accuracy not yet measured

rules.name: Eye protection (goggles)
rules.note: Needs the second model; small item, judged only on larger workers

rules.name: Worker down (fall or collapse)
rules.note: An emergency alert, not a violation: nobody is penalised for falling. Video only

rules.name: Respirator or mask in dust or fumes
rules.note: Needs a model trained for it

rules.name: Ear protection near loud machinery
rules.note: Needs a model and a way to know where it is loud

rules.name: Safety harness when working at height
rules.note: Needs a model and a way to know the working height

rules.name: Entering a restricted zone
rules.note: Needs the zones drawn on each camera view
